type_definitions.definition: A disorder of structure or function in a human, animal, or plant, especially one that produces specific symptoms or that affects a specific location and is not simply a direct result of physical injury.
A nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.
A structured group of people with a particular purpose, such as a business, government department, or charity.
A human being.
One of the seven days of the week.
A specific amount or number of something.
A specific classification of a virus, often characterized by its genetic makeup and host range.
A group of drugs that have similar chemical structures, the same mechanism of action, and are used to treat the same disease.
A structure with a roof and walls, such as a house, school, or factory.
A large and densely populated urban area.
An official role or office within a government.
One of the twelve periods of time into which a year is divided.
An official announcement by an authority that a state of emergency exists.
A particular day, month, and year, or a specific point in time.
A group of living organisms consisting of similar individuals capable of exchanging genes or interbreeding.
A principal administrative division of certain countries or empires.
An organization that gathers news reports and sells them to subscribing newspapers, periodicals, and broadcasters.
The length of time that something continues or exists.
A place, amenity, or piece of equipment provided for a particular purpose.
A permanent or semi-permanent organization in the machinery of government responsible for the oversight and administration of specific functions.
An organized group that resists the government or ruling power.
